name: Bayworks
long_description:
Self-driving companies record every mile a car drives. Nobody records how it gets fixed.

We capture how technicians fix cars and use it to run the dealership’s operations, making every repair faster and more consistent.

In four months, we have gone from 0 to $843K in cARR across six dealership groups, including a top-50 US group ($3Bn annual revenue), and have powered over 50,000 repairs.

launches.title: Bayworks: Intelligence that keeps America’s vehicles running
launches.tagline: Self-driving companies record every mile a car drives. Nobody records how it gets fixed.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**\
Bayworks is building the intelligence that keeps America’s vehicles running. We capture voice and video data as technicians repair cars and verify the work, turning this ground truth into a system that runs the dealership’s operations and standardizes every repair.

In 110 days, we’ve gone from 0 to 80+ dealerships covering 4,000 repairs a day, including a top-50 US dealer group ($3B+ annual revenue).

<https://youtu.be/OS67nQnzcAA>

**The Problem**\
Every single day, over a million cars drive in for repair across America, and the industry doesn’t have enough technicians to fix them. Repair expertise lives in technicians’ heads: undocumented, unstructured, and disappearing as the shortage grows.

**The Solution**\
Bayworks captures voice and video data as technicians repair cars and verifies the work. Every repair becomes ground truth for how cars get fixed: symptom, diagnosis, fix, outcome. This compounds into a system that runs the dealership’s operations and standardizes every repair, making it faster and compliant with manufacturer specifications.

**The Team**\
We’re both engineers from BITS Pilani.

Kaustubh built voice AI at Sarvam, India’s frontier AI lab, deployed across government and public enterprises, and previously worked in automotive retail lending.

Shubham built the underwriting engine at Navi, a $2B fintech, powering $10M+ in loans every day. At Scapia, he was the first credit-risk engineer and built the mobile app that scaled to millions of users.

Reach us at [founders@bayworks.app](mailto:founders@bayworks.app).
